character.name: Varg Marrock
character.background: Disgraced knight (oathbroken paladin), falsely accused of treason
traits: Stoic demeanor: Rarely displays emotion, even when grievously wounded or publicly humiliated.
Unflinching honesty: Cannot tell a lie, even when a falsehood could spare him persecution or pain.
Haunted by guilt: Carries the weight of every life lost in the ambush that framed him, believing he could have prevented the tragedy.
Unbreakable resolve: Will not abandon a quest once he has sworn to see it through.
character.gear: Ancestral longsword · Dented scale mail · Cracked house shield · Vial of healing draught · Cracked holy symbol · 3 field rations · Dented brass tinderbox · Frayed wool bedroll
character.story: Varg Marrock was the youngest knight of House Marrock, sworn to protect the western border of the realm. The night his liege lord was assassinated, Varg was framed for the murder, his oath broken under torture, his divine favor stripped. His house was erased, his friends executed, and he was left for dead in the frozen borderlands. He now wanders, stoic and guilt-ridden, seeking to prove his innocence or kill every man who betrayed him. He broke his oath not to save himself, but to protect the last survivor of the ambush—a child hidden in the castle walls.

inventory.name: Ancestral longsword of House Marrock
inventory.lore: Forged for the first lord of House Marrock three centuries past, this blade is etched with the house’s wolf sigil. It grew warm in its scabbard the night of the ambush that framed Varg, as if recognizing the traitors who wore his house’s colors.
inventory.description: A well-balanced steel longsword, polished to a mirror sheen despite its age.

inventory.name: Dented scale mail
inventory.lore: Passed down through Varg’s line, this scale mail bears a deep dent in the left pauldron from the mace blow that knocked him unconscious during the ambush. The inner lining is still stained with the blood of his childhood friend, executed alongside him.
inventory.description: Interlocking metal scales riveted to a leather backing, dented but still functional.

inventory.name: Cracked house shield
inventory.lore: Bearing the shattered sigil of House Marrock, this shield was broken when Varg took a blow meant for his liege lord moments before the lord was killed. He has kept it ever since as a reminder of his failure to protect those under his care.
inventory.description: A heavy wooden shield faced with pitted steel, cracked down the center.

inventory.name: Vial of healing draught
inventory.lore: Brewed by a hedge witch who believed Varg’s claims of innocence after he saved her village from a bandit raid. It is the only act of kindness he has received since his exile.
inventory.description: A thick, crimson liquid that smells faintly of honey and rosemary.

inventory.name: Cracked holy symbol of the Oath of Devotion
inventory.lore: Given to Varg when he took his Oath of Devotion. It cracked the instant he broke his vow, and no longer glows with divine light, but he carries it as a reminder of the promise he failed to keep.
inventory.description: A tarnished silver sun disc, split down the middle with a jagged crack.
inventory.effects: Currently inert, but may reignite if Varg rededicates himself to a righteous oath.

inventory.name: Field rations
inventory.lore: Scavenged from the supply wagons of the ambushed caravan that framed Varg. He forces himself to eat only one a day, punishing himself for the lives he could not save.
inventory.description: Dried salted meat and hardtack, tough but nourishing.

inventory.name: Dented brass tinderbox
inventory.lore: Taken from the body of a fallen household guard in the ambush. Varg uses it to light small fires at night, staring into the flames as he replays the night of the betrayal over and over.
inventory.description: A brass tinderbox with a flint striker, dented from being dropped during the ambush.

inventory.name: Frayed wool bedroll
inventory.lore: Mended with thread from the cloak of Varg’s childhood friend, who was executed for treason alongside Varg. He sleeps on it every night, the rough wool a constant reminder of what he lost.
inventory.description: A frayed, patched bedroll, thin but enough to keep out the worst of the cold.
